verdict.rationale: Vapi's own docs describe two testing capabilities. Voice Test Suites have an AI tester call your agent and follow a script that simulates customer behavior. Evals is a testing framework that runs mock conversations with automated validation before production. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing features, and deeper detail on validation criteria and reporting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: Voice Test Suites enable you to test your AI voice agents through simulated phone conversations.
Our AI tester calls your voice agent and follows a script that simulates real customer behavior.
Evals is Vapi's AI agent testing framework that enables you to systematically test assistants and squads using mock conversations with automated validation.
you'll create mock conversations, define expected behaviors, and validate your agents work correctly before production
